name: Long Silence Mid-Call
description: Tests the turn manager's silence watchdog and retry prompt — the caller answers, then goes quiet.
intent: You are an elderly Hindi speaker. Say 'नमस्ते' and then stay completely silent for a long time. Do not respond to further questions.
personality: Elderly, hard of hearing, distracted, speaks Hindi.
expectBehaviour: Agent issues one retry prompt, waits, then ends the call gracefully rather than hanging.
